body: Hidden gem! Hopefully a total white, transparent and soft pink backgrounds in the widget will be implemented, checkmark directly from the widget itself, custom icons left of the title in widget and ‘day streak’ and ‘total streak’ too as it keeps me motivated.
author: 🐘 𝐂𝐎𝑴𝐎

title: Great app but could improve
body: I love the app, it’s simplistic and effective. Although when i set a goal for 1x a week i see the activity every day eventhough i only would have to do it once. Also graphs would be nice to track your progress
author: fontysssss

title: 5/5 app
body:
Really easy to use and doesn’t ask ANY money. 
Really in love with this app. My number one recommendation for anyone looking for a habit tracker 🙌🏼
author: Ongebruikte bijnaam voor S

title: Amazing, free and works
body: Rare to find an app that works, gets updated, and does not ask money. Thanks for this!
author: SPC-feedback

title: Onrise
body:
Good app, but it does not save the marks. The next day all boxes are empty.

Would be nice if you can choose different days routine. And more colors for the taskbar. Also if i do widget, it shows the widget with task bar, but it says no data.
author: Kokosnoot777

title: Great app!
body:
I really like the app, especially how it merges a habit tracker with a focus timer! 

Could you consider adding a feature for a locked screen with a timer?
author: Rina Yugay

title: Nice but no day view
body: All habits are stacked in 1 view which is a bit messy, you have a small calendar at the top, why not show onlynthe habits for today per day? Because I can select on which days I want a habit (for instance running, I don’t run every day)
author: SomeRandomDutchGuy

body: I’ve used lots of similar apps and this one just takes the cake.
author: Timoteíí

title: Great
body: Such a great little app. It helps me alot. Thank you!
author: Duyff

title: De beste app voor kleine dagelijkse taken
body:
Werkt soms super verslavend en leuk om te doen. Omdat je er een spelletje van kan maken. 
Ik zou meer verschillende widgets willen zien.
author: Muffin meisje

title: Nice and simple
body: Very straight to the point simple to use. Also allows for some personalisation which I think is really nice. It would be nice if there was some sort or calendar function to see how you did even if you lost a streak; now if you loose a streak, there’s no way to tell how you might did before
author: Synvn

title: Heel fijn maar ik mis iets
body:
Geweldige app, werkt supergoed, lekker simpel, geen reclame, maar er zijn een paar instellingen die ik mis:
-een instelling om je habits uit te zetten voor vakantie
- een instelling om een habit meerdere keren per dag af te strepen
Voor de rest is deze app echt aan te raden!!
author: Skategirllll

title: Very good but..
body: It is a very good app, but I miss an Apple Watch app. So I can do my habits without distractions on my phone.
author: Seth.Ni

title: Incredible app
body: Thanks for creating this app. Contains all the best habit tracking features, like unlimited habits, for free. Best app for habit tracking
author: tmdebo

title: Fantastisch
body: Deze superhandige, gratis app biedt meer dan waar je normaal driemaal voor moet betalen. Heel makkelijk in het gebruik, leuk om mee te werken en ziet er gelikt uit.
author: Levanooo

title: Prima
body: Doet wat het moet doen zonder allerlei afleidende extra’s. Enige wat wel een beetje irritant wordt is als je een habit aanmaakt zonder notificaties dat die dat steeds vraagt of je het zeker weet.
author: Duizelig321

title: Amazing!
body: Amazing app! An Apple Watch function would be a great addition.
author: O.Werkhoven
